claims.title: Load-safe exchange: independently observable temporary-path cuts and finite recovery

quoted_fields.interface: Bounded purpose-built accessible terrestrial fixture family, initially serviceable connection, simultaneous total resultant force≤1kN and moment≤250Nm INCLUDING deployed module, adapters and tool reactions. Replace fastening/key or pin/bush wear sets in bolted-face and fixed-strut-end joints; qualify replacement while every temporary path has a locally observed cut and nearby retained catch, then recover temporary anchors, tooling and stocks. Bounded calibrated force/gap errors, known contact/stiffness range and explicit independent single-fault escape; not arbitrary legacy retrofit or arbitrary hidden defect certification.
quoted_fields.failure: Positive lock engagement, assembled10–36MN/m stiffness, installed gap/force errors, fitted-joint play, harness isolation, controlled preload release and manufacturing durability are qualification assumptions. Finite geometry checks and48 dynamic samples are not full robot/contact trajectories or universal movement bounds. The conservative motion total is an upper bound above target, not a measured exceedance. All unquoted costs/lives are introduced allowances. Maker data retain producer exposure; earlier held ATI index and other identities are not recovered or released.
